Their meet T = (s ∧ t)* is a point pair, and its two points are (T ± √(T²)) (∞ ⌋ T) (Dorst, Fontijne and Mann). When T² < 0 the circles miss each other. Two lines also meet at ∞, so their pair is a flat point and the point is o ⌋ T; parallel lines have none.
